definition.name: Sands of Renewal
definition.subtitle: One hundred levels. A new in-game journey.
definition.description: A free, 100-level journey through Arrakis. Gather, craft, fight, build, explore, supply and guide other travellers through 100 in-game quests. Every path offers 50,000 Season XP and can reach level 100; solo travellers need no guild or group events. Unlock a permanent dashboard cosmetic at every level. Submit your gameplay evidence for moderator review, with optional in-game rewards delivered through separate administrator approval.
